name: header-havoc
description: Chrome extension that injects or removes HTTP headers on URLs matching glob or regex patterns.

scripts.package: npm run build && rm -f header-havoc-*.zip && cd dist && zip -qr "../header-havoc-$npm_package_version.zip" . -x '*.DS_Store' && cd .. && echo "packaged header-havoc-$npm_package_version.zip"
